cleanliness.label: Cleanliness
cleanliness.definition: How clean the space, bedding, and bathroom were, including smells and pests.
cleanliness.decision_rules: Insects and pests are coded here because guests experience them as a cleanliness problem.

location.label: Location
location.definition: Distance to attractions, walkability, the neighborhood, views, and scenery.
location.decision_rules: Views and scenery are coded here. A porch or deck as a feature of the unit is coded as amenities.

host_communication.label: Host communication and hospitality
host_communication.definition: Responsiveness, helpfulness, recommendations, welcome gestures, and how disputes were handled.
host_communication.decision_rules: General praise of the hosts ("great hosts") is coded here.

check_in.label: Check-in and access
check_in.definition: Finding the property, instructions, entry, private entrances, and physically getting from parking to the door.
check_in.decision_rules: Steep drives, steep walks from parking, and tight passages to the door are coded here because they affect access (and accessibility).

listing_accuracy.label: Listing accuracy
listing_accuracy.definition: Whether the property matched its description, photos, or the guest's reasonable expectations.
listing_accuracy.decision_rules: Undisclosed layout facts that would have changed the booking decision (for example thin shared walls) are coded here.

comfort.label: Comfort
comfort.definition: Beds, furniture, space, temperature, light, decor, and overall comfort.
comfort.decision_rules: Space, decor, coziness, and temperature are coded here. A space heater mentioned as keeping guests warm is comfort; a list of supplies is amenities.

amenities.label: Amenities
amenities.definition: Wi-Fi, appliances, kitchen, supplies, parking, outdoor spaces, and plumbing.
amenities.decision_rules: Statements that a place is basic or has no frills are coded as neutral amenities.

noise.label: Noise
noise.definition: Quiet or noise from streets, neighbors, the host's household, or the surroundings.
noise.decision_rules: "Quiet", "peaceful", and "tranquil" are coded as positive noise because they describe the absence of disturbance.

value.label: Value
value.definition: Whether guests felt the stay was worth the price.
examples: you get what you pay for
value.decision_rules: Mentions of price are coded here only when the guest judges the price, not when it is simply stated.

safety.label: Safety, security, and privacy
safety.definition: Locks, window coverings, shared internal access, and how safe the neighborhood felt.
examples: no way to lock the door
safety.decision_rules: Privacy from outside view or intrusion is coded here. A general liking for a private, secluded space is coded as other.

other.label: Other
other.definition: Relevant observations that do not fit elsewhere, mainly general appreciation of privacy and seclusion.
other.decision_rules: Use sparingly. General praise that names no specific aspect ("Awesome place!") is not labelled.

no_window_coverings.description: No curtains or blinds, leaving guests without privacy from outside.

shared_internal_access.description: Internal doors, laundry, or garage give other occupants access to the guest space.

pests_insects.description: Spiders, ants, or other insects in the unit.

poor_cleanliness.description: Dirty surfaces, bedding, or bathroom; mildew; musty smells.

noise_from_adjoining_residence.description: Footsteps, music, pets, or other noise from the attached home or upstairs occupants.

listing_mismatch.description: Features or photos in the listing do not match the property.

layout_not_disclosed.description: An important feature of the setup (shared walls, known recurring problems) was not disclosed.

temperature_control.description: Guests cannot control the temperature, or the unit is too cold or too warm.

worn_or_dated_furnishings.description: Worn, torn, run-down, or dated furniture and decor.

neighbor_light_disturbance.description: Outside lighting from a neighboring property disturbs sleep.

basic_for_extended_stays.description: Suitable for sleeping only, not for spending time in.

steep_access.description: Steep drive, driveway, or walk from parking to the door; may be difficult for older or less mobile guests.

narrow_door_access.description: Tight passage between the stairs and the wall to reach the door.

hard_to_find.description: Address numbering or GPS directions are confusing.

parking_conditions.description: Parking is on grass, far from the door, blocked by others, or the parking pass is broken.

insufficient_supplies.description: Too few towels, no soap, or other missing basics.

plumbing_water_pressure.description: Weak water pressure or toilet back-up.

hot_water_bath.description: Bathtub water does not get hot.

odd_kitchen_layout.description: Kitchen is organized in an inconvenient way.

minor_maintenance.description: Small fixtures in need of repair.

host_unresponsive_or_rude.description: Host was unhelpful, unavailable, dismissive, or rude.

neighborhood_in_transition.description: Some nearby properties are run down or under renovation; some guests may feel uncomfortable.
